title: Delhi Court Grants Bail To Human Rights Activist Khurram Parvez, Journalist Irfan Mehraj In UAPA Terror Funding Case
description: A Delhi Court today granted bail to human rights activist Khurram Parvez and Kashmiri journalist Irfan Mehraj in a 2020 UAPA case. Mehraj and Parvez were accused in the alleged NGO Terror funding case registered by NIA in October 2020. Principal and Sessions Judge Pitamber Dutt of Patiala House Court passed the order. A detailed order is awaited. With this bail order, the Court has paved way for release of Khurram Parvez. He was granted bail recently in another UAPA case by the Delhi High Court.
